audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] describes Hero's Entrance vaguely as "more of a team tool" with no cost attached.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180 seconds at rank 1 with 4000-5500 range and it shields every ally in the landing zone. Naming the cooldown is what makes "he spent it elsewhere" actionable for you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every interaction line on the page reduces to "Justice Punch is his dash knockup". Shield of Durand is never mentioned, and tradeGood/breakdown.trading tell you to make Galio "burn his sidestep tool" — Galio has no sidestep in his kit.
audit.why: The decisive sequence is Justice Punch (650, 11s at rank 1) into Shield of Durand's taunt, which only reaches 275 — deny the punch and the taunt cannot arrive. Galio moves slowly while charging Shield of Durand, which makes a charging Galio the easiest Flash Frost target in the lane, and the same button is his shield, so baiting it out is the burst window missingInteractions flags. Crystallize is terrain and Justice Punch is a dash, so the wall genuinely stops the charge. Range ladder: Flash Frost 1075 versus Winds of War 825.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Galio's E with a "terrain: creates terrain" flag.
audit.why: Riot's own description of Justice Punch is a backward step and a charge that knocks up the first champion hit — it creates no terrain. Per the brief's rule, the description wins over a misfiring derived flag. Nothing on the page depended on it, so no text change was needed; recording it so the flag is not trusted later. All three suspectNames entries are false positives: Hero's Entrance and Glacial Storm are both real ability names.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Crystallize for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and it is his only gap-close — with it down, a taunt that reaches 275 cannot reach you. - Shield of Durand slows him while it charges: that is the easiest Flash Frost in the lane.

edits.before: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Galio wins by punching in, taunting you at 275 range, and shielding through the burst you had saved.
